items.title: Binance Invests $100 Million in Circle, Expands Stablecoin Partnership
items.summary: Binance, the largest crypto exchange, has made a $100 million investment in Circle Internet Group as part of a partnership to promote Circle’s flagship USDC stablecoin in emerging markets.  A spokesperson for Binance said the exchange will integrate USDC into existing and new digital-asset products tailored for savings and investment, while offering incentives such as lower spot trading fees on USDC-denominated trading pairs.  Circle’s USDC is the world’s second-largest stablecoin, with a market cap of $75 billion.

items.title: Why Coinbase (COIN) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session as crypto-related equities stayed bid after a Securities and Exchange Commission order on tokenized stocks, and after the company opened IPO allocations to retail users.
